subject: mathematics
concept: Reading and interpreting a pictogram (picture graph) with a key
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student places virtual icon tiles to represent counted groups, following a given key
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured pictogram with a 'each icon = 2' style key and answers questions
exercise.abstract: Student calculates totals from a pictogram where one icon represents more than one unit

misconception_flags: counts icons as one unit each, ignoring the key's stated value

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
